note: Schema documents describe the authoring contract. They are documentation: the loader skips content/schemas/ and they do not affect the catalog hash.

units.power: integer power-unit milli-units; power is never a stored commodity
units.no_floating_point: the loader rejects fractional and exponent literals outright

identifiers: lowercase ASCII letters, digits and underscore; 1..64 characters

planets[].workers: working-age workers; must not exceed population
planets[].stocks: resource map; must not exceed the planet's capacity

scenarios[].expedition: one-use charter; cargo may not exceed the debited launch cost
scenarios[].freight: the single reusable freighter and its route endpoints
scenarios[].mandate: the external supply demand, its dates and its negotiated alternative
scenarios[].completion: the completion predicates and their thresholds
scenarios[].survival: the survival-emergency and failure day counts
scenarios[].events: ids of the events active in this scenario
